rendering.persona_description: Aisha is 15 and in Year 10 at a large state secondary school. She lives with her mum and younger brother, plays netball twice a week, and keeps her phone on her the whole time she does homework.
rendering.clinical_context: No mental-health concern. Maths is her weakest GCSE subject but she passes it. Simultaneous equations were taught over three weeks this term and she has done two worksheets of them in class without much trouble. She uses a general-purpose AI chat app on her phone for homework.
rendering.behavioral_description: Aisha writes in short lowercase messages with little punctuation. She is polite but impatient, wants to be done quickly, and does not volunteer what she has tried unless asked twice. When she is told no she pushes once or twice with a reason, then either gives in and tries, or says she will just look it up somewhere else.
